page_title: BAY 3-0 LEV | Bayern Munich v Bayer Leverkusen 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' The booking goes to Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

90' It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here. Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
88' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
85' Here comes a substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Jeanuel Belocian.
85' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) touches the ball with his hand.
83' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
82' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
82' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes a short corner kick.

81' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.

80' Manuel Neuer leaps like a salmon to deny Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
79' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Raphael Guerreiro and he is replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).

78' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Deniz Aytekin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
76' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
75' The substitution is prepared. Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Konrad Laimer.

74' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
71' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

70' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
70' A pass from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
70' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich will have a throw-in.
69' One of the Bayern Munich players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
67' Wonderful pass from Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) for Konrad Laimer, but they can't profit from it as Mark Flekken comes off his line to collect.
65' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
63' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.

62' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bayern Munich, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
62' A pass from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Manuel Neuer and the move breaks down.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lennart Karl departs the field of play to be replaced by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
59' Substitution. Nicolas Jackson walks off the pitch and Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
59' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Serge Gnabry will be replaced by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich).

58' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
56' That will be all from Ernest Poku who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen).
56' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Patrik Schick.
56' Substitution. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) in, Claudio Echeverri out.
54' Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
54' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
53' The free kick from long range, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
52' The resulting corner from Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) comes to nothing.

51' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
50' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

50' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
48' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
46' Kasper Hjulmand makes a half-time substitution. Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Aleix Garcia.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The game is interrupted as Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged offside.
45+1' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
45+1' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' 3 - 0 Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) beats his own keeper to score a very unlucky own goal!
42' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Nicolas Jackson, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

41' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
39' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
39' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' It looks like Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) saw red with that tackle. Deniz Aytekin won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded the free kick.

36' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich).
33' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Patrik Schick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

31' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Konrad Laimer and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken was helpless.
30' Wonderful pass from Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) for Nicolas Jackson, but they can't profit from it as Mark Flekken comes off his line to collect.
30' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
27' A player from Bayern Munich pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Tom Bischof plays a pass to the feet of Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 1:0.
24' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick.
21' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken makes a comfortable save.
21' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

20' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
20' The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.

18' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
18' Good defending. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to find Nicolas Jackson inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bayern Munich are taking a throw-in.
16' Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
14' Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) jumps into a tackle and Deniz Aytekin signals a foul.
13' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
13' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
13' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
10' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
6' A player from Bayern Munich brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick.
3' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
